about: Plain-language summary of what the agent has learned about each person's tastes. Shown and editable under Settings on the calendar. When a person edits their summary, the agent treats every statement in it as correct and keeps it.

aaron.summary:
What I'm working from:
- Big yes: repertory and revival film — noir, Hitchcock, Lynch, character actors, sad and humane stories (you flagged the Kore-eda After Life revival).
- Electronic, experimental and ambient music and DJ nights at artist-run spaces (Junglist Heights, Halloween ATP at Current Space).
- Adventurous jazz in small rooms; DIY electronics and synths; photography and small galleries.
- Less likely: arena pop and tribute acts, kids-only programming, sports, pub crawls.

From your flags (19 Interested, none Not interested yet):
- History and old houses are your strongest thread: Doors Open, Profs & Pints on haunted houses, the Baltimore Museum of Industry social night.
- Nature and gardening keep showing up: the Filbert Street Garden bat walk and microgreens workshop, Mushroom City at Carrie Murray.
- Talks and author events are a clear yes (Riley Black at the Pratt, Profs & Pints).
- Creative Alliance is a favorite venue (comedy, a Celtic Halloween folk show).

No new flags since Monday, so nothing shifted. This week I leaned into that history-and-talks thread: a dozen Baltimore Heritage tours (Green Mount, the Westminster catacombs, the 1869 Masonic Temple), Pratt and Red Emma's author talks, holiday open houses at Evergreen and Hampton, plus the Senator Theatre's revival series (The Birds, Network, Anatomy of a Murder) and more Keystone Korner jazz.

stacey.summary: Stacey isn't currently set up as a flagger on the calendar (removed under People), and she never flagged anything, so there's nothing learned yet. If she's added back, her flags will fill this in — or write what she likes here.
